description: Jamaica national boundary as one MultiPolygon (10,956 km2) from OCHA COD-AB Jamaica v01 admin level 0, with the national 2011 census totals by sex and age from COD-PS Jamaica joined on adm0_pcode = JM (T_TL = 2,697,983). Useful for clipping, for the ISO3 join key (iso3 = JAM) and as the national row when comparing with WorldPop 2020 estimates. Retrieved from HDX on 2026-09-23 via the CKAN API (package_show cod-ab-jam, cod-ps-jam).
